about: 18 synthetic hotel-engineering tickets (12 English, 6 Thai) with hand-written labels, written for this module on 2026-10-17. Not real guests or sites. Small on purpose: it teaches HOW to compare engines fairly, it cannot crown a winner.

labels.safety: true when the ticket describes smoke, burning, fire, sparks or water near electricity

tickets.text: Room 1203 is too warm, the thermostat says 29 degrees and the AC only blows warm air.
Could we get two extra bath towels and more coffee pods in 812 when someone is free?
The toilet in 1507 keeps running and now water is spreading across the bathroom floor.
There is smoke coming out of the electrical panel next to room 1203 and the lights are flickering.
We would like to extend our stay by two nights and move to a room with a city view.
Water is dripping from the ceiling right onto the TV and the power socket in 905.
The AC was noisy last night but it is fine now, no need to send anyone.
Burning smell in the corridor on floor 6 near the laundry chute, please check right away.
I was charged twice for the minibar on checkout, please refund one of them.
The shower drain in 1104 is slow and the tub fills up while we shower.
Do NOT turn off the chiller tonight, the ballroom event runs until 2am and the room is already warm.
Sparks came out of the hair dryer socket in 702 when my daughter plugged it in.
แอร์ห้อง 1203 ไม่เย็นเลย เป่าลมร้อนออกมา
ขอผ้าเช็ดตัวเพิ่มอีกสองผืนที่ห้อง 812 ค่ะ
มีน้ำหยดจากเพดานในห้องน้ำ พื้นเปียกหมดแล้ว
ได้กลิ่นไหม้แถวตู้ไฟชั้น 3 ใกล้ห้อง 1203 รีบมาดูด่วนค่ะ
ขอเลื่อนเวลาเช็คเอาท์เป็นบ่ายสองโมงได้ไหมคะ
ไม่ต้องส่งช่างมาแล้วนะคะ แอร์กลับมาเย็นแล้ว
